name: Admin can create a vendor
description: Creates a vendor from the admin screen, filling the one required field, and confirms it appears in the vendor list.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as admin@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Navigate to /Admin/Vendors and click the control to add a new vendor
In the Vendor Name field, which is the only required field on this form, type E2E Probe Vendor
Also fill the optional Contact Person field with Probe Contact and the Phone field with 03001234567
Click the save button at the bottom of the form
Assert the vendor list is shown and contains a row named E2E Probe Vendor. If the form is still displayed with a validation message, this test must fail.
